message:
Merge pull request #20 from sourcegraph/cc/add-status

Add status blurb to the README

pr.title: Add status blurb to the README
pr.body: Since this repo got publicized a little before it had the opportunity to be tested rigorously internally, it's only fair to call out that there may be changes to the public API until we stabilize on a 1.0 release.

diff: diff --git a/README.md b/README.md index 021db73..26bbe18 100644 --- a/README.md +++ b/README.md @@ -452,3 +452,11 @@ func mapStream( + +# Status + +This package is currently pre-1.0. There are likely to be minor breaking +changes before a 1.0 release as we stabilize the APIs and tweak defaults. +Please open an issue if you have questions, concerns, or requests that you'd +like addressed before the 1.0 release. Currently, a 1.0 is targeted for +March 2023.

explanation.what: PR #20をマージし、README.md に「Status」セクションを新設して、conc がpre-1.0であり1.0リリース前にAPIやデフォルト値に破壊的変更が入りうること、1.0は2023年3月を目標としていることを明記した。
explanation.why: PR本文に "Since this repo got publicized a little before it had the opportunity to be tested rigorously internally, it's only fair to call out that there may be changes to the public API until we stabilize on a 1.0 release." とあり、公開が社内での十分な検証より先行したため、利用者に安定性についての期待値を事前に示す意図。直前の pool デフォルト変更(seq83)のような破壊的変更が今後も起こりうることの予告でもある。

highlights.note: Status セクション追加。1.0リリースまでは破壊的変更がありうる旨の明記
